name: MONOREPO-001-F02 Document reuse of the Calendar design for future apps

scenarios.name: MONOREPO-001-S04 Find the reusable design through the developer guide

steps.text: the developer has the app-suite checkout
the developer follows the design reuse guide from the repository README
each reference to the shared design resolves to a versioned definition or documented public usage example
the guide identifies the existing Calendar visual elements that are shared and how a future application uses them without copying their definitions
Calendar is documented as a consumer of that shared design
the guide distinguishes shared presentation from Calendar-specific date calculations and navigation

scenarios.name: MONOREPO-001-S05 Find the steps for adding and delivering an independent application

steps.text: the developer has the app-suite checkout
the developer follows the application addition guide from the repository README
the guide describes how to assign a separate Android application identity and reuse the shared design
the guide describes how to build and test one application and locate its APK
the guide describes how to keep application versions, private data, permissions and signing credentials independent
the guide identifies the Calendar checks to rerun when shared design changes
the guide does not require creating a second product to build Calendar
